AuthLogin.title: Welcome back
AuthLogin.subtitle: Sign in to pick up right where you left off.
AuthLogin.passkeyFailed: That passkey didn't work. Try again or use your password.
AuthLogin.ssoNeedsEmail: Enter your work email above to continue with single sign-on.
AuthLogin.ssoUnavailable: No single sign-on is set up for that email. Use your password or a passkey.
AuthLogin.ssoEnforced: This account signs in with single sign-on. Use "Sign in with SSO" instead.
AuthLogin.ssoError: Single sign-on didn't complete. Please try again.

SsoLink.title: Link your account
SsoLink.subtitle: This email already has a Connex account. Enter its password once to connect single sign-on — you won't need it again.
SsoLink.successMessage: Single sign-on is now linked to your account
SsoLink.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
SsoLink.invalidBody: Account-linking links are single-use and expire quickly. Start the single sign-on flow again to get a new one.
SsoLink.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

AuthForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
AuthForgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
AuthForgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset your password. The link expires soon, so use it right away.

AuthResetPassword.title: Set a new password
AuthResetPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use anywhere else.
AuthResetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
AuthResetPassword.invalidBody: Reset links expire after a short time. Request a new one to continue.
AuthResetPassword.breachedPassword: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different password that you don't use anywhere else.
AuthResetPassword.passwordScreeningUnavailable: Password breach screening is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

AuthConfirmEmail.title: Verify your email
AuthConfirmEmail.subtitle: Confirm this is your email address to finish setting up your account.
AuthConfirmEmail.successBody: Your email address is confirmed. You're all set.
AuthConfirmEmail.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
AuthConfirmEmail.invalidBody: Verification links expire after a while. Sign in and request a new one from your account.

AuthVerifyEmail.title: Confirm your new email
AuthVerifyEmail.subtitle: Confirm this is your new email address to finish updating your account.
AuthVerifyEmail.successBody: Your email address has been updated. You'll use it to sign in from now on.
AuthVerifyEmail.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
AuthVerifyEmail.invalidBody: Email-change links expire after a while. Sign in and request a new one from your account.

AuthRegister.title: Create your account
AuthRegister.subtitle: Start keeping every client relationship in one place.
AuthRegister.registerFailed: We couldn't create your account. Please check your details and try again.

AuthForm.formHasErrors: There is an error in the form. Please check and correct the highlighted fields.
AuthForm.breachedPassword: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose a different password that you don't use anywhere else.
AuthForm.passwordScreeningUnavailable: Password breach screening is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

AuthBrand.caption: The CRM for teams who close by staying close.

AuthConfirmPasskey.title: Confirm passkey enrollment
AuthConfirmPasskey.subtitle: Confirming this link lets you add the first passkey to your administrative account.
AuthConfirmPasskey.successBody: Go back to your security settings and add your passkey. This confirmation expires shortly.
AuthConfirmPasskey.invalidTitle: This link is invalid or has expired
AuthConfirmPasskey.invalidBody: Enrollment confirmations are single use and expire quickly. Request a new one from your security settings.
AuthConfirmPasskey.signInBody: Open this link in the same browser where you started enrolling, after signing in.
